verdict.rationale: Appwrite ships an official MCP server explicitly meant to let LLMs interact with Appwrite's API/docs via natural language, and hands-on probes confirm it installs and runs (though it requires API credentials before serving). This supports AI-native natural-language operation but is credential-gated and there's no end-to-end demonstration of a natural-language command actually driving Appwrite via MCP or CLI in practice. Missing for 10: hands-on proof of successful NL-driven command execution, evidence of broader NL interfaces beyond MCP (e.g. chat-based admin), and independent corroboration of real-world use.
